channel.title: The Munsif Daily - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Munsif Daily (munsifdaily.com)

item.title: Assam polls: BJP’s 10-days mass outreach programme to kick-start tomorrow
item.description: The BJP will on Saturday kick-start Jana Ashirwad Yatra - an outreach programme aiming to connect with masses before the upcoming Assembly polls in Assam.

item.title: T20 WC: ‘I’ve done it role for MI, whatever team needs, I am up for it’, says Tilak on change in batting position
item.description: India batter Tilak Varma said he wanted the team's batters to instil fear in Zimbabwe’s bowlers by attacking on every delivery, which led to them getting a huge 72-run win to keep their semifinal hopes alive in the 2026 Men’s T20 World Cup.

item.title: Clean the system, not just booths: Shiv Sena(UBT) in ‘Saamana’ on mandatory voting
item.description: Shiv Sena Uddhav Balasaheb Thackeray (UBT) has responded to the Supreme Court’s recent observations on mandatory voting by questioning the very foundation of India’s current electoral system.

item.title: Delhi court grants bail to JNU students arrested during protest march
item.description: According to the police, around 300 protesters attempted to take out a “Long March” without permission. When police personnel tried to stop them by putting up barricades, the protesters allegedly engaged in scuffles and assaulted officers.

item.title: Festive cheer for 18 lakh employees, pensioners: CM Yogi instructs officials to disburse salaries before Holi
item.description: The Yogi Adityanath government on Friday issued instructions for the disbursal of salaries and pensions for the month of February before Holi festival, bringing cheers and smiles on the faces of about 18 lakh staffers as well as pensioners.

item.title: Sanya Malhotra fulfils dream by celebrating 34th birthday with a sports carnival
item.description: Actress Sanya Malhotra marked her 34th birthday with a sports carnival she had been dreaming of hosting for the past two years.

item.title: Manish Malhotra says Kareena Kapoor’s ‘Poo’ costumes from K3G became a part of pop culture
item.description: Ace Bollywood designer Manish Malhotra, in a post on his social media account stated that Kareena Kapoor Khan’s costumes from Kabhi Khushi Kabhie Gham went on to become pop culture even after 25 years of the film’s release.

item.title: Ensure that Reform Express reaches grassroots level, PM Modi urges stakeholders
item.description: Prime Minister Narendra Modi on Friday said that this year’s Union Budget lays the road map for a 'Viksit Bharat' — driven by technology, reforms and finance — and all the stakeholders need to collectively ensure that reforms reach the grassroots level.

item.title: Jharkhand municipal polls: Counting underway for 48 urban bodies
item.description: The elections to 48 Urban Local Bodies (ULBs), including nine Municipal Corporations, 20 Municipal Councils, and 19 Nagar Panchayats, were held on February 23, recording an impressive voter turnout of around 62 per cent.

item.title: T20 WC: West Indies cannot be taken for granted; India needs a smart plan to handle their batting threat, says Gavaskar
item.description: Defending champions India registering a comfortable 72-run win over Zimbabwe may have steadied nerves in the camp, but legendary opener Sunil Gavaskar stated that they cannot afford to take two-time champions West Indies lightly and the Men in Blue need to come up with smart plans to tackle the Windies batting threat when the two teams meet in a cracking winner-takes-it-all Super Eights showdown in Kolkata on Sunday.
